semantics.H1: Native V5 gate first, then reject rank not S/A for every current Frozen Entry, irrespective of occupancy/time/release type; rejected candidate does not occupy picked slot.

semantics.future_information: Evaluation book/exit plans isolated from admission; only funded or already-held positions access suffix. No future labels, availability, IDs or schedules at admission.
semantics.release_order: Original known mark then confirmed fill/cash release then BUY; same timestamp release applies without new delay.
semantics.same_batch: Inherited stable candidate_order; native gate occupancy=actual positions+accepted picked; allocation once; no backfill after lot/cash failure.
